diffReceipt.command: git diff --check (repair working diff before commit)

firstDiagnostic.method: Real RAF / shipped M1 entry, Resume as needed, actual six Braves+Shaman, public Brave HUD selection and canvas-owned authored Lightning(11,1) click. Camera assistance before mode setup. Public Buildings/Hut mode then automatic Spells preserves Hut at handoff and arrival. Observers armed before commands. Stock belongs to next world turn, not an unconditional 82-turn claim.

cost: One row per launch. Route deadline sum 690s (11.5min); harness ceiling sum930s (15.5min), including startup margin. Baseline route120s, harness180s. These are ceilings, not measured durations. Stop after first diagnostic until its receipt is reviewed.
checkpointBoundary: Save checkpoint before worship orders, host-awaited readCommittedCheckpoint via waitForCheckpointReadback; fresh page reload then public Load Game. Subscription clones the replacement before automatic resume. Compare exact level/turn/time and actor/terrain/stock hashes; full digest retained, no byte-equality claim because migration resets transient panel reservations. Read stored record again after load. Acquire and resize on fresh page. No storage writes except normal public Save, no export/import.

hooks.restoration: Reverse installation order; restore original own property or delete observer-created own property; error if owner changed. Original callback once, sync, same receiver and arguments. Never replace the RAF owner or pause/RNG/world state.

pixels: Actual same-frame world canvas PNG and actual overlay crops. Canonical source bytes are separately hashed. Source-backed command/draw-binding comparison reuses production layout helpers and is not an independent full raster oracle. Optional bounded opaque-texel correspondence checks support only sampled pixels; absent eligible zero-angle scaled samples remain unproved. Intentional interpolation, original GPU pixels and hardware performance retain their stated limits.
followOnAcceptanceNotCovered: in-flight controller save/restart with early observation
launchTemplate: POPULOUS_WORSHIP_ROUTE=<one enumerated row> node <reviewed-runtime-root>/scripts/local-render/harness.mjs --game-root <reviewed-runtime-root> --browser <verified official browser> --scenario <reviewed-runtime-root>/scripts/local-render/ordinary-worship.mjs --port <parent-reserved-port> --timeout <row harness ms> --profile <reviewed-runtime-root>/work/local-render-profiles/ordinary-worship-<unique-row-run> --output <reviewed-runtime-root>/work/orchestration/ordinary-worship-<unique-row-run>
launchPreconditions: Parent first integrates/copies only the frozen new scenario into the application/runtime worktree and records the actual source fingerprint; no permission to change runtime dependencies follows from this preparation.
For baseline retain accepted89c9629 HEAD and enumerate the same reviewed scenario in that worktree; mark POPULOUS_WORSHIP_BASELINE=1; no candidate asset/runtime expectations.
Verify installed browser/dependency/harness hashes, fresh private profile/output and unique loopback port before launch; no M3 profile/surface; no competing browser/full job.
Harness starts only its owned server/browser and validates source/runtime unchanged plus owned cleanup. Preserve failed outputs/profiles; do not silently rerun or adopt locks.

repair.readiness: Before every worship selection: public Resume if needed; bounded real-clock inputMask loop uses public visible Skip or awaits completion; existing host-awaited waitForShamanReadiness; explicit current scene/store, connected canvas, no loading, unpaused and zero-mask assertions. Per-order readiness/skip observations retained.
repair.save: After settings dialog appears, assert paused current scene/store identity and connected/not-loading, then record turn and click Save.
repair.drawing: Selected samples bracket only original presentation.draw with deep clones of complete owned acquisition state and gameplay/cosmetic RNG; assert equality. No whole-scene RNG invariance claim. Require matching prior binding, fraction strictly between 0 and 1, and changed x/y/scale/radians in an actual captured intermediate frame.
repair.pixels: Up to 8 opaque interior source texels per eligible zero-angle >=2-device-pixels/texel sample are mapped from actual Canvas arguments/transform to actual overlay RGBA and compared exactly. No eligible sample is explicitly unproved. No independent full raster oracle and no native GPU equivalence.
